notes.title: Abashed is featured in The Lovecraftian Days 2025 and Indie Game Utsav festival!
notes.content:
I'm very excited to share that Abashed is featured in the Indie Game Utsav and Lovecraftian Days 2025 festival!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188644/12764b98ad6c7d287bedb40055a26f763c03f627.png

Lovecraftian Days celebrates games that emphasize the terror of the unknown and incomprehensible. The term 'Lovecraftian' is named after the author H. P. Lovecraft, whose work is characterized by these themes.

Indie Game Utsav is a celebration of over 100 indie games made in India!

If you haven't had the chance to try out the new extended demo yet, now would be the time! I've also pushed several fixes and quality of life improvements along with the new content based on your feedback.

What next?
I will continue to push fixes and improvements, and more exclusive limited-period content will be available in the future.
Please feel free to join our Discord community to see regular dev updates, post bug reports, or chat with me!

With gratitude,
Supantha

notes.title: Extended Demo Now Available as part of The Storyteller's Festival 2025
notes.content:
I'm very excited to share that Abashed is part of the Official Selection of The Storyteller's Festival 2025! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188644/aab14b45418405be415e29f8c8ffa5bed9a91401.png

As part of this event, you can now play an extended demo with a new area where you'll meet a new character!
You can continue the game and pick up right where you left off, but it's suggested to start a new game and experience the full demo in one sitting.

notes.title: Abashed Demo Now Available in 6 Languages!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188644/3600ac81584d11ca5208096fac3781d7269f941e.png

Hey everyone!

I'm excited to share that the demo for Abashed is now fully localized in the following languages:


 English (en)
 Chinese (Simplified) - 中文
 German (de) - Deutsch
 Japanese (ja) - 日本語
 Russian (ru) - Русский
 Spanish (es) - español


If you speak any of these languages and encounter an issue, or if you would like to request localization for your language, please consider joining our Discord community to chat with me!

Happy weekends!



with gratitude,
Supantha

notes.title: Abashed Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
I'm super excited to share that the Abashed demo is now available to play!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188644/7c748c8bc1877801a9b98325b07635a9e61e2e56.png

The demo provides a glimpse of what you can expect from the game. A bigger demo is on its way and will be available by the end of next month!
The game is as much about Issac's journey as it is about my own—a story of pushing through uncertainty and embracing vulnerability to uncover hidden truths. I hope you find yourself as immersed in this world as I was in creating it.

What now?
If you face any issues while playing the demo, have any suggestions, or simply want to talk about it, please feel free to join our Discord community! 

With gratitude,
Supantha Paul
